description: Register an address and auto-ingest its description to memory. Returns immediately with job_id and status queued; work runs on the plugin worker.
embedding_description: Queue a named address registration with typed endpoint fields, optional tags and memory auto-ingest. Returns job_id and status queued before storage or embedding runs. Retrieve service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal; job.result contains address_id and optional memory_id. Do not repeat a write because a poll is delayed.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job handle with job_id and status; the final response is stored in job.result.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Retain this exact job_id. Schedule job_service::get_job while queued or processing; inspect terminal result or error before using the final data. Do not repeat a write because a poll is delayed.
